applies_when: Product or shelf-edge area is at or near eye level in frame
check: Is there graphical/brand messaging present at eye level, not just the product itself?
suggestion: Add eye-level graphical messaging to reinforce brand presence at the point of highest visibility

applies_when: Product is shelved without any raised signage or riser
check: Is a riser present with additional brand messaging?
suggestion: Consider adding a riser to increase messaging height and visual separation from competitors

applies_when: A PDQ or standalone display case is present, or a new/LTO product is visible
check: Does the PDQ highlight a new product launch, LTO, or product line extension?
suggestion: Use PDQ space to spotlight new launches or line extensions for attention

applies_when: Product packaging shape is stackable (boxes, cans, etc.)
check: Is the product arranged to take advantage of its stackability?
suggestion: Reconfigure into a stacked display to increase visual footprint and shelf presence

applies_when: A complementary-use product is shelved near, but not merchandised with, its pairing product
check: Is there a PDQ, box display, or signage bridging the two related product categories?
suggestion: Add a PDQ tray or shelf-edge signage pairing the two products to reinforce brand cohesion

applies_when: Shelf messaging or signage is present
check: Does the messaging match the brand's visual identity (colors, logo, tone) and include benefit/result callouts?
suggestion: Update messaging to align with brand identity and include clear benefit callouts

applies_when: Any signage or packaging is present
check: Is there a QR code or digital element tying the in-store display to the online product page?
suggestion: Add a QR code linking to the product page to bridge in-store and online presence

applies_when: Visible shelf or pegboard space adjacent to the product
check: Is allocated shelf space fully utilized with no significant empty gaps?
suggestion: Restock or resize facing to eliminate empty shelf space

applies_when: A sample display or trial-size unit is present
check: Does the sample header include brand-cohesive messaging?
suggestion: Add branded header messaging to the sample display for cohesion
